image_description: A low-light, high-contrast photograph of a traffic intersection at dusk or dawn. The scene is dominated by a dramatic sky with crepuscular rays breaking through dark clouds. Several traffic lights are suspended on wires and mounted on poles; they appear as dark silhouettes against the bright sky, though some red signal lights are illuminated. The foreground contains silhouetted vehicles and road infrastructure.
